what: Screen-wide big text (aircraft name · wordmark) stays pinned at the top of the section (80px below the header), and below it an image (top-down airplane · cut-out product) starts half a screen height later, rises with scroll and passes over the text covering it. When the section ends the text rises with it — only sticky and stacking order, no script

options.--fx-top: Height where the text sticks (via style), default 0 — if there is a header bar, its height (original 80px)
options.--fx-gap: Distance by which the picture starts late beneath the text (via style), default 50vh

use:
AB-12

Painting the background faded from top to bottom (original purplish gray → 65% white) makes the image look like it descends from the sky.

from.where: index.html .es — original es-slide (__sticky: sticky top 80px · padding 48px 80px · text clamp(80px, 34vw, 1000px) 700 · .9 · −.04em / __plane: margin-top 50vh · z-index 2 / background #716e85 → white 65%)
